title: Principal thickening obstruction boundary
statement: For any commutative ring R, g in R and open W of Spec R [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let I_n be the image of multiplication by the restricted g^(n+1) on O_W. There exists a family of additive boundaries from global sections of the nth principal thickening to H^1(W,I_n). A section with zero boundary lifts to a section of O_W. For every map kappa:I_m -> I_n commuting with the ideal inclusions and every scheme morphism h:W_n -> W_m over W, delta_n(h.appTop(t))=H^1(kappa)(delta_m(t)). No torsion bound or cohomology vanishing is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0H3D and 0H3E (quotient comparison); Tag 01DZ, Section 20.2 (universal delta-functor)

proof.text: Apply principal_thickening_cokernel_sections to identify the degree-zero cohomology of the cokernels of image inclusions with thickening sections, compatibly with restrictions and induced quotient maps.

For each n, form the explicit short complex image(p_n) -> O_W -> cokernel(image inclusion). It is short exact by ShortComplex.exact_cokernel. Define the additive boundary by H.delta in degree zero composed with the inverse section comparison. H.ker_delta_eq_range_map_g supplies a degree-zero ambient preimage of a boundary-zero section; H.zeroLinearEquiv and the comparison equation turn it into the required ambient section.

Construct the morphism of these explicit short complexes with components kappa, identity, and cokernel.map. The private proved boundary_naturality lemma follows from ShortExact.extClass_naturality and associativity of Ext composition. Apply it to this morphism, then use the functorial section-comparison equation to identify the induced quotient pullback with h.appTop.

mathlib_searches.query: Connecting homomorphism of a short exact sequence of sheaves is natural and its kernel consists of sections lifting to the middle sheaf
mathlib_searches.results: Generic ShortComplex.ShortExact boundary and Mayer-Vietoris facts. Upstream Modules.H.ker_delta_eq_range_map_g (Lean name H.ker_δ_eq_range_map_g) and H.δ exist in Cohomology.LongExact; quotient/thickening identification is still required.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Second reader: no exact principal-thickening boundary theorem. QuotientBaseChangeIdeal and PrincipalQuotientMultiplicationImage are component tools, not duplicates.

lean.statement:
theorem principal_thickening_obstruction
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (g : R) (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens) :
    ∃ δ : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W n, ⊤) →+
          Modules.H (principalThickeningIdeal R g W n) 1,
      (∀ n t, δ n t = 0 → ∃ a : Γ(W.toScheme, ⊤),
        (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W n).appTop a = t) ∧
      (∀ (n m : ℕ)
        (κ : principalThickeningIdeal R g W m ⟶ principalThickeningIdeal R g W n)
        (h : FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W n ⟶
          FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W m),
        κ ≫ image.ι (principalThickeningMultiplication R g W n) =
            image.ι (principalThickeningMultiplication R g W m) →
        h ≫ FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W m =
          FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})) W n →
        ∀ t, δ n (h.appTop t) = Modules.H.map κ 1 (δ m t))
